question: How should logistic regression be fitted with exact hyperparameter conventions?
alternatives: Implement full-batch GD with exact specs: 200 iter, lr=0.1, logit clip [-30,30]
rationale: Task specifies exact fitting trajectory (200 steps, no convergence criterion, fixed lr, logit clipping). Reference solution uses this exact trajectory. Sklearn convergence would not match. Must implement custom GD.
decision: Implement full-batch gradient descent with exact specifications: 200 iterations, learning rate 0.1, logit clipping [-30, 30], weight/bias initialized to 0, L2 penalty applied per spec.
expected_effect: Reproducible fitting trajectory that exactly matches reference solution; enables fair comparison across lambda values and compression schemes.
falsifier: If fitted model Brier score differs from reference by >0.001 on same data/fold, implementation deviates from spec.
